description: Broken Alliances Level 50 Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst and obtain the Runestones. Place the runestones in the Seal of the Earth to free Blacklash and Hematus. Slay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus, and the Sign of the Earth to Gorn. Requirements: - Blacklash's Bindings - Chains of Hematus
name: Broken Alliances
